messages:
jess: Heads up — RC candidate ready for promo. Artifact: redwood-inference@v2.14.0-rc2. Asking for pin + signoff for the 16:00-17:00 PT change window. CI and preflight QA green; one flaky eval called out in the notes.

jess: checklist attached in thread, will trigger kv-warm and canary via deploy-bot.

daniel: +1 from runtime. Confirming KV warm and scale policies are included in the promote flow?

jess: yes — deploy script will run kv-warm -> canary -> steady ramp. See command below.

jess: ```/deploy promote rc-2 --pin v2.14.0-rc2 --window 2026-03-18T16:00-17:00PT --canary 5% --kv-warm true```

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: job/5521. Prechecks: infra OK, capacity reserved. Smoke tests: pending.

priya: QA note — release-notes delta includes quantization change to the encoder kernels. We observed ~3% token throughput regression on our long-seq perf test (8k). Tagging the observation in the notes: <https://internal/release-notes/rc2|release-notes/rc2>.

kira: I'm the sheriff for the window. My rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% (token-level), p99 latency +150ms vs baseline, or >10% regen failure across a slice. If we hit any, we rollback immediately and re-pin the previous stable (v2.13.9).

alex: Can we do a short staging dry-run of the canary script first? If the staging run is clean we proceed with prod. Staging bake 15m recommended.

daniel: ops vote: propose the three rollback criteria above. Also suggest ephemeral debug flag off by default. Vote? :thumbsup:/:thumbsdown:

priya: :thumbsup: QA approves. Run the staging dry-run now please.

deploy-bot: Staging dry-run started (job/5520). Output snippet: ```[run 00] kv-warm ok; [run 01] canary-init ok; smoke: PASS```. No flakes in staging.

jess: Good. Starting prod promote in 10m. I'll wait for final ack from sheriff and runtime.

kira: Hold for first 10m of canary to evaluate SLOs and error surface. If clean, give green for ramp.

daniel: Acknowledged. Runtime standing by for traffic ramp.

16:00 (deploy-bot): Canary initiated in prod (canary id 5521) at 5% traffic. Smoke tests running. Logs: ```canary[5521]: init ok; gen_latency_p50=42ms p99=125ms; errors=0.06%```

16:10 (priya): Quick QA check at +10m: p99 up +20ms, errors steady. No regen failures in sampled prompts. Recommend ramp to 50% over 20m.

16:15 (kira): Observability agrees — traces show no new error classes. I give green to ramp.

16:30 (daniel): Rolling to 100% per ramp schedule. Monitoring closely for latency and error budgets.

16:35 (deploy-bot): Promotion complete. Production pinned to redwood-inference@v2.14.0-rc2. Jobs: canary job/5521 -> completed, promo job/5521 -> success.

16:38 (priya): Post-deploy quick smoke passed. Regression alerts quiet. Updating release notes and tagging the rollout in release tracker.

16:45 (jess): Thanks all — oncall and SRE notified for night watch. Closing the promo thread. If any post-deploy regressions surface, follow rollback playbook and re-open thread. :tada:
